title: Etale criterion for geometric connectedness of a fibre
statement: Let $g:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $s\in S$. The scheme-theoretic fibre $X_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically connected if and only if, for every etale neighbourhood $(U,u)\to(S,s)$, the base-changed fibre $X_u=X\times_SU\times_U\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(u)$ is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme].

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 37.53.6 (Tag 03GZ, label lemma-characterize-geometrically-connected-fibres, line 15219)
